shortDescription: Indian Navy SSC Officer June 2027 Online Form – application last date extended. Apply at joinindiannavy.gov.in.
content:
Indian Navy has invited online applications for Short Service Commission Officers – June 2027 course.

The application last date has been extended as per official notice. Selection is through shortlisting and SSB interviews followed by medical examination.

Apply only on joinindiannavy.gov.in and read branch-wise eligibility carefully.
